content: Solid Queue does not retry automatically - retries come from ActiveJob retry_on. Delivery is at-least-once: a deploy can interrupt execution mid-job and a retry re-runs it, so job bodies must be idempotent. Existing concurrency controls can BLOCK duplicate jobs with the same arguments (they wait then run after) but there is no way to DISCARD duplicates outright (GH issue #176). Future-scheduled jobs live in solid_queue_scheduled_executions until a dispatcher moves them into solid_queue_ready_executions; they survive deploys as rows but deserialize against the NEW code, so renaming/removing a job class or changing its argument signature breaks in-flight scheduled jobs (ActiveJob::DeserializationError). Recurring task keys in config/recurring.yml are DB keys, not labels - renaming them loses run tracking.
